claims.title: Hastings refutes additivity of the minimal output entropy
claims.text: Hastings constructs pairs of random unitary channels, the second obtained from the first by complex conjugation, for which the maximally entangled input makes S_min of the product strictly smaller than the sum of the individual minimal output entropies. The argument uses concentration of measure for random unitary Kraus operators in large but finite dimension, and via Shor's equivalence it simultaneously refutes additivity of the Holevo capacity and of the entanglement of formation.
